about_the_game:
Pathfinder 2 RPG - Pathfinder Adventure Path #214: The Broken Palace (Shades of Blood 2 of 3)

Delving deeper into the ruined prison, the PCs make their way through cell blocks now inhabited by subterranean monsters and undead echoes of the past, before finding themselves in what appears to be an idyllic village where the sun crosses the clouded sky each day. The clueless villagers are being preyed upon by their vampire masters and the PCs must break the spell and ascend into the Broken Palace to remove the threat of Lady Nalushae once and for all.


The Broken Palace  is a Pathfinder Adventure for four 4th-level characters. This adventure continues the Shades of Blood Adventure Path, a three-part monthly campaign where a group of adventurers explore a ruined ancient prison to stop a vampiric threat to cover the skies in shadow. This volume also includes a look into the faith of Zura, demon lord of vampires and cannibalism, and a toolbox of new magic items, an ancient relic that replicates the sun, and a selection of devious bloodthirsty monsters.

Written by: James Jacobs 

This product is not a PDF or accessible outside of Fantasy Grounds. It has been lovingly converted for use within Fantasy Grounds and features the following additions:

<ul> <li> All maps resized and set up with a preset grid to make combats easy to manage</li>
<li> Individual area descriptions linked to maps, containing new encounters, treasure parcels and descriptions for just that area</li>
<li> Tokens for each encounter are all pre-placed in starting locations on the map. You can edit these on the fly.</li>
<li> Drag and drop treasure parcels and Encounter XP that is easily awarded to your players to keep the game moving ahead</li>
<li> All the images and handouts from the book available to share with your players as you need them</li>
</ul>"
